name: Aspariegos (Spain)
description: Divided into three diagonal parts from the lower fly to the upper hoist: green at the lower hoist, red in the centre and blue at the upper fly.
history: The arms and municipal flag were approved by the full council of Aspariegos in its session of 14 November 2003 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 10 June 2004; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of three colours of its arms, green as a right triangle, red in the middle and blue as a right triangle at the upper fly.

features.role: broad diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
right triangle at the lower hoist
right triangle at the upper fly
